| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 98%, Benign 1%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% | Strong Normal call, 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal} (90% target coverage, ECE 5%) | Single class at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 44th OOD percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Typical image quality, unflagged input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (93%–96% similarity) [F5] | All nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 2, 7) · ↓ invasive · Strongest shift away from invasion (-1.06) [F2], 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text score (-0.67 shift) [F3]; 18/20 check, caption inconsistent · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.53 shift) [F4] with 20/20 AI spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability more than random (+0.0114; 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); top driver **Normal lobules** is Unreliable (0/20 check).

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is **Benign** like contrast case `BACH_0369` (90% similarity), separated by **invasion** and Unreliable **mitoses** (0/20 check).
- Focal lesion affects surgical margins, where simulated frozen-section segments reach 87%–88% probability below the 100% threshold.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 2, 7**: Confirm normal two-layered lobules directly, since this Unreliable concept failed AI spot-checking (0/20).
2. **Regions 8, 11**: Inspect region 8 for stromal invasion (score 0.98) and region 11 (highest tile risk).
3. **Regions 3, 8, 9**: Check superior, medial, lateral, and inferior margin segments peaking at 87%–88% probability.
